cohort: 144 postpartum death cases were included for analysis, and controls were mothers who survived six weeks after childbirth
finding: The determinants of postpartum death in Selangor, Malaysia included the presence of preexisting medical or surgical illness, place of birth, mode of birth, place of antenatal care and Malaysian ethnicity-citizenship.
mod_finding: Women who underwent caesarean section had almost three times more odds of postpartum death.
